title: Category-Specific Sentinel-2 NDVI Differences among Level-1C, Sen2Cor, and LaSRC in a Tropical Silvopastoral Landscape: Open Science Reproducibility Compendium
description: Reproducibility compendium (manuscript source, code, figures, derived tables, manifests, provenance and environment records) for a Sentinel-2 NDVI method comparison across Level-1C/TOA, Sen2Cor L2A/SR, and LaSRC L2A/SR observations in a tropical silvopastoral landscape of the Colombian Orinoco Piedmont (2019-2020; 1,797 common polygon-by-date observations from 106 management polygons on 22 farms). Farm-boundary and management-polygon geometries are governed by the Sustainable Cattle Ranching project and are not publicly distributed.
